user.title: Add Climate Guard Switch
user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.guard: Guard switch — protect a heater/cooler relay
menu_options.history: History view — temperature, target and heating/cooling in one chart (read-only)

guard.title: Create Climate Guard Switch
guard.description: Configure a filtered proxy switch for your climate heater/cooler.

data_description.sun_entity: Optional. When set, the target only runs while the sun is above the horizon.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Pairs with Allowed Weather States below to gate the target on current weather.
data_description.climate_entity: Optional. Linking a thermostat lets a manual temperature change bypass an active cooldown once.
data_description.allowed_weather_states: Only used when a Weather Entity is set above. Leave empty to allow any weather.
data_description.heartbeat_interval_seconds: How often the running switch is re-pulsed (keeps the hardware's own auto-off timer refreshed) and how often the Run Limit cutoff is checked. Set to 0 to disable both — including Run Limit enforcement, even if Run Limit itself is set above 0.

history.title: Create History view
history.description:
Adds a read-only device with sensors for the target temperature and for the temperature while heating / while cooling, so a chart card can show the temperature, its target and the heating/cooling periods together for any date range. The entities can come from any integration.

History starts when this device is added. The sensors are kept as long-term statistics indefinitely. See the README for card examples.

data_description.name: Used as the device name.
data_description.temperature_sensor: The temperature the heating/cooling marks are drawn on. Required.
data_description.climate_entity: Optional. Adds the Target temperature sensor (the target line).
data_description.heating_entity: Optional. Marks the periods this is on in the chart. Pick the physical relay so the chart shows what actually ran, not what was requested.
data_description.cooling_entity: Optional. Marks the periods this is on in the chart. Pick the physical relay so the chart shows what actually ran, not what was requested.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Climate Guard Switch
reconfigure.description: Change the device type. Target entity, gates, and heartbeat are configured via Options instead.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.history_reconfigure: History views have no device type — use Configure to change their inputs.
